# Sales Club by Your Best Next Move

> Sales Club is a 12-week online peer group for UK solo founders and micro B2B service businesses who want a repeatable way to win clients beyond referrals. It is run by Paul Service, founder of Your Best Next Move (YBNM), a sales and growth consultancy based in Hove, East Sussex. Maximum 12 members per cohort. £600 + VAT for all 12 weeks. The next cohort starts on Tuesday 10 November 2026.

## What's included

- Six fortnightly two-hour group sessions on Zoom, Tuesdays 1pm to 3pm
- Six optional one-hour drop-in clinics in the weeks in between
- One 1:1 session with Paul Service
- Recordings if you miss a session
- Practical templates (cold email, pitch deck and proposal templates and more)
- A private WhatsApp group for ongoing support

## The 12 weeks

- Weeks 1 to 2: score your growth gears and find your purpose
- Weeks 3 to 4: get crystal clear on your ideal client
- Weeks 5 to 6: package and price what you do
- Weeks 7 to 8: decide what you stand for and how you say it
- Weeks 9 to 10: put your message to work online
- Weeks 11 to 12: turn it into a repeatable sales process

## Who it is for

Solo founders and small B2B service businesses (typically 1 to 10 people) who are good at what they do, have some clients, and rely too heavily on referrals. Businesses already well past that stage are better suited to Paul's 1:1 work.

## How to join

Apply for the next cohort at https://salesclub.yourbestnextmove.com/. Applying is free and leads to a short call with Paul.
